core: RNA virus genome replication and translation
name: RNA virus replication, transcription and host translation control
rationale: All members concern RNA virus genome replication, transcription, RNP handling and viral or host translation control (PKR/IFIT evasion, host translation shutoff), unlike confusables centred on editing restriction, retroviral DNA integration or viral entry/maturation.

name: Immunoglobulin gene diversification and early B cell commitment
rationale: Members cover V(D)J recombination, somatic hypermutation and pre-B/B lineage commitment, distinguishing them from APOBEC editing, general mismatch repair and T cell or CD4 proliferation confusables.

name: Repulsive axon guidance and midline crossing decisions
rationale: Members are axon guidance processes dominated by chemorepulsion, SLIT/ROBO commissural midline choice and specific tract guidance, unlike confusables centred on ROBO-RAC signalling, netrin attraction, semaphorins or ephrins.

name: Epithelial anion transport by CFTR and SLC26 exchangers
rationale: Members concern chloride, iodide, sulfate and oxalate transport by CFTR and SLC26 transporters and their diseases, unlike confusables built on SLC12 cation-chloride cotransport, SLC4 bicarbonate transport or aquaporins.

qualifier: termination, NMD, no-go and non-stop decay
name: Translation termination and NMD, no-go, non-stop mRNA decay
rationale: Members cover translation termination and the ribosome-coupled mRNA decay routes, unlike confusables about nuclear mRNA 3'-end processing and export, rRNA/Pol III transcription, or nascent-peptide ribosome quality control.

qualifier: M-CSF-driven monocyte, macrophage and dendritic cell
name: M-CSF signaling in monocyte, macrophage and dendritic cell development
rationale: Members concern M-CSF signalling and the differentiation and proliferation of monocytes, macrophages and myeloid dendritic cells, unlike confusables on granulocyte/G-CSF development or generic interleukin SHC signalling.

qualifier: viral nucleic acid sensing via IRF3/IRF7
name: Viral RNA sensing and IRF3/IRF7-driven type I interferon production
rationale: Members describe RIG-I/MDA5, ZBP1 and TLR7/8/9 sensing that drives IRF3/IRF7-dependent IFN-alpha/beta production, unlike confusables on cytosolic DNA sensing, interferon responses (OAS) or viral evasion.

qualifier: degron-rule and ubiquitin-independent routes and their restraint
name: Degron-rule and ubiquitin-independent proteasomal degradation and its restraint
rationale: Members cover N-end and C-degron rule and ubiquitin-independent proteasomal degradation plus its negative regulation (incl. UCH deubiquitinases), unlike confusables on protein destabilisation, ribosome QC or stress granules.

name: IL-11, CNTF and other IL-6-family autocrine/paracrine cytokine signaling
rationale: Members concern IL-6-family cytokine receptor-ligand signalling (IL-11, CNTF, LIF/OSM) with autocrine and paracrine action, unlike confusables centred on IL-6/JAK-STAT3 itself or M-CSF signalling.

name: Monocyte surface markers, TLR7/8 and CD1 lipid antigen presentation
rationale: Members combine monocyte surface signatures, TLR7/8 and antigen presentation including CD1/MHC class Ib lipid antigens, unlike confusables dominated by dendritic-cell signatures and MHC class II peptide presentation.

name: Adrenergic, adenylate cyclase-inhibitory control of smooth muscle tone
rationale: Members concern smooth muscle contraction/relaxation across vascular, urogenital and uterine beds together with alpha-2 adrenergic and Gi/Gz adenylate cyclase inhibition, unlike confusables on cGMP/endothelin, adenosine or cardiac contraction.

core: amino sugar and sialic acid metabolism
name: Amino sugar, sialic acid and lysosomal ganglioside catabolism
rationale: Members cover N-acetylglucosamine, mannose and sialic acid metabolism and lysosomal hexosaminidase/sialidase ganglioside breakdown, unlike confusables on N-glycan synthesis, glycosphingolipid biosynthesis or GAG/mucopolysaccharidosis degradation.

qualifier: efflux, reverse transport and foam cell restraint
name: Cholesterol efflux, reverse transport and foam cell restraint
rationale: Members regulate cholesterol efflux, reverse cholesterol transport, uptake and storage with LXR control and foam-cell restraint, unlike confusables on SREBP-driven synthesis or HDL/LDL particle assembly and remodelling.

name: ERBB2 kinase-domain mutant resistance to tyrosine kinase inhibitors
rationale: All three members describe ERBB2 kinase-domain mutants resisting TKIs, unlike confusables on ERBB2/EGFR mutant signalling, FGFR fusions or PDGFR/ALK drug resistance.

core: DNA damage tolerance and repair synthesis
qualifier: translesion polymerases and NER gap filling
name: Translesion synthesis and nucleotide-excision repair gap filling
rationale: Members cover translesion synthesis by Y-family polymerases and NER repair synthesis, unlike confusables on replicative DNA synthesis, BER gap filling or telomere C-strand synthesis.

qualifier: attachment, entry, envelope protein maturation and assembly
name: Viral attachment, entry, envelope protein maturation and assembly
rationale: Members span virion attachment and entry, maturation of envelope/spike/3a proteins and virion assembly, combining what confusables split between entry-only and nucleoprotein-maturation sets.

name: Testicular somatic and germ cell development
rationale: Members cover Sertoli and Leydig cell development, seminiferous tubule formation and germ cell proliferation and meiotic entry, unlike confusables on gonadotropin and ovarian follicle regulation.

qualifier: primitive streak, lateral plate mesoderm and hindgut
name: Primitive streak, lateral plate mesoderm and hindgut morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern gastrulation, primitive streak formation, lateral mesoderm and posterior gut morphogenesis, unlike confusables on endoderm specification, mesendoderm and cardiac mesoderm.

name: Rhesus glycoprotein ammonium and carbon dioxide transport
rationale: All members concern Rh-glycoprotein-mediated ammonium and CO2 transport, unlike confusables on aquaporins, bicarbonate transporters or erythrocyte gas exchange.

core: DNA damage and replication stress response
qualifier: ADP-ribosylation and DNA break site recruitment
name: Replication stress and DNA break response with ADP-ribosylation
rationale: Members cover responses to replication stress and DNA lesions (camptothecin, hydroxyurea, R-loops, DNA-protein crosslinks, break-site recruitment) with ADP-ribosylation control, unlike confusables on fork reversal, telomere maintenance and DNA topology.

qualifier: TLR-driven IRAK/TRIF activation of TAK1 and IKK
name: TLR-triggered TAK1/IKK activation and canonical NF-kappaB signaling
rationale: Members describe Toll-like receptor IRAK1/2 and TRIF/TRAF6 activation of TAK1 and IKK leading to canonical NF-kappaB, unlike confusables on TNFR1, non-canonical NF-kappaB or TAK1-JNK/p38.

name: PDGF receptor signaling in mesenchymal fibroblast activation
rationale: Members are PDGF receptor signalling regulation together with mechanoresponsive fibroblast programmes and hyaluronan synthesis, unlike confusables on Hippo/YAP, KRAS or ECM-dominated stroma.

name: Linkage-specific ubiquitin chain assembly and deubiquitinase editing
rationale: Members concern E1/E2/E3 ubiquitination with specific chain linkages and their removal by USP, OTU and JAMM deubiquitinases, unlike confusables on proteasome assembly, aggrephagy or protein quality control.

name: Small GTPase regulation by GEFs, GAPs and geranylgeranylation
rationale: Members concern activity control and prenylation of Rab, Ral, ARF and Rho GTPases, unlike confusables on vesicle budding, Golgi trafficking or ER protein targeting.

name: rRNA gene transcription and its nucleolar chromatin regulation
rationale: Members cover RNA polymerase I rRNA transcription steps, 5S rRNA Pol III transcription and nucleolar chromatin regulators (NoRC, B-WICH, SIRT1), unlike confusables on tRNA/snRNA Pol III transcription, rRNA processing or translation initiation.
